Detect your OS (Linux / macOS / WSL) 2. Verify Python ≥ 3.10 and Node.js ≥ 18 3. Install OpenHarness via `pip` 4. Set up the React TUI (`npm install`) if Node.js is available 5. Create `~/.openharness/` config directory 6. Confirm with `oh --version` ### Prerequisites - **Python 3.10+** and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) - **Node.js 18+** (optional, for the React terminal UI) - An LLM API key ### One-Command Demo ```bash ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_key uv run oh -p "Inspect this repository and list the top 3 refactors" ``` ### Install & Run ```bash # Clone and install git clone https://github.com/HKUDS/OpenHarness.git cd OpenHarness uv sync --extra dev # Example: use Kimi as the backend export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_kimi_api_key export ANTHROPIC_MODEL=kimi-k2.5 # Launch oh # if venv is activated uv run oh # without activating venv ``` ### Configure A Workflow Use the unified setup flow instead of manually thinking about `auth -> provider -> model`: ```bash uv run oh setup ``` `oh setup` walks through: 1. Choose a workflow: - `Anthropic-Compatible API` - `Claude Subscription` - `OpenAI-Compatible API` - `Codex Subscription` - `GitHub Copilot` 2. For compatible API families, choose a concrete backend preset 3. If needed, authenticate the selected workflow 4. Pick or confirm the model 5. Save and activate the profile Compatible API families currently guide you through presets such as: - `Anthropic-Compatible API`: - Claude official - Moonshot / Kimi - Zhipu / GLM - MiniMax - `OpenAI-Compatible API`: - OpenAI official - OpenRouter Arbitrary compatible endpoints are still supported through advanced profile commands: ```bash oh provider add my-endpoint \ --label "My Endpoint" \ --provider anthropic \ --api-format anthropic \ --auth-source anthropic_api_key \ --model my-model \ --base-url https://example.com/anthropic ``` OpenHarness stores API-key-backed compatible profiles with profile-scoped credentials when appropriate, so different compatible endpoints do not have to share one global key.

### Non-Interactive Mode (Pipes & Scripts) ```bash # Single prompt → stdout oh -p "Explain this codebase" # JSON output for programmatic use oh -p "List all functions in main.py" --output-format json # Stream JSON events in real-time oh -p "Fix the bug" --output-format stream-json ``` ## 🔌 Provider Compatibility OpenHarness treats providers as **workflows** backed by named profiles. In day-to-day use, prefer: ```bash oh setup oh provider list oh provider use ``` ### Built-in Workflows | Workflow | What it is | Typical backends | |----------|------------|------------------| | **Anthropic-Compatible API** | Anthropic-style request format | Claude official, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, internal Anthropic-compatible gateways | | **Claude Subscription** | Claude CLI subscription bridge | Local `~/.claude/.credentials.json` | | **OpenAI-Compatible API** | OpenAI-style request format | OpenAI official, OpenRouter, DashScope, DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, Groq, Ollama, GitHub Models | | **Codex Subscription** | Codex CLI subscription bridge | Local `~/.codex/auth.json` | | **GitHub Copilot** | Copilot OAuth workflow | GitHub Copilot device-flow login | ### Compatible API Families **MiniMax** | custom Anthropic-compatible endpoint | `minimax-m1` | #### OpenAI-Compatible API Any provider implementing the OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` style API works: | Backend | Base URL | Example models | |---------|----------|----------------| | **OpenAI** | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-4.1` | | **OpenRouter** | `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` | provider-specific | | **Alibaba DashScope** | `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` | `qwen3.5-flash`, `qwen3-max`, `deepseek-r1` | | **DeepSeek** | `https://api.deepseek.com` | `deepseek-chat`, `deepseek-reasoner` | | **GitHub Models** | `https://models.inference.ai.azure.com` | `gpt-4o`, `Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct` | | **SiliconFlow** | `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1` | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3` | | **Groq** | `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` | `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` | | **Ollama (local)** | `http://localhost:11434/v1` | any local model | ### Advanced Profile Management ```bash # List saved workflows oh provider list # Switch the active workflow oh provider use codex # Add your own compatible endpoint oh provider add my-endpoint \ --label "My Endpoint" \ --provider openai \ --api-format openai \ --auth-source openai_api_key \ --model my-model \ --base-url https://example.com/v1 ``` For custom compatible endpoints, OpenHarness can bind credentials per profile instead of forcing every Anthropic-compatible or OpenAI-compatible backend to share the same API key. ### GitHub Copilot Format (`--api-format copilot`) Use your existing GitHub Copilot subscription as the LLM backend. Authentication uses GitHub's OAuth device flow — no API keys needed. ```bash # One-time login (opens browser for GitHub authorization) oh auth copilot-login # Then launch with Copilot as the provider uv run oh --api-format copilot # Or via environment variable export OPENHARNESS_API_FORMAT=copilot uv run oh # Check auth status oh auth status # Remove stored credentials oh auth copilot-logout ``` | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Auth method** | GitHub OAuth device flow (no API key needed) | | **Token management** | Automatic refresh of short-lived session tokens | | **Enterprise** | Supports GitHub Enterprise via `--github-domain` flag | | **Models** | Uses Copilot's default model selection | | **API** | OpenAI-compatible chat completions under the hood | --- ## 🏗️ Harness Architecture OpenHarness implements the core Agent Harness pattern with 10 subsystems: ``` openharness/ engine/ # 🧠 Agent Loop — query → stream → tool-call → loop tools/ # 🔧 43 Tools — file I/O, shell, search, web, MCP skills/ # 📚 Knowledge — on-demand skill loading (.md files) plugins/ # 🔌 Extensions — commands, hooks, agents, MCP servers permissions/ # 🛡️ Safety — multi-level modes, path rules, command deny hooks/ # ⚡ Lifecycle — PreToolUse/PostToolUse event hooks commands/ # 💬 54 Commands — /help, /commit, /plan, /resume, ... mcp/ # 🌐 MCP — Model Context Protocol client memory/ # 🧠 Memory — persistent cross-session knowledge tasks/ # 📋 Tasks — background task management coordinator/ # 🤝 Multi-Agent — subagent spawning, team coordination prompts/ # 📝 Context — system prompt assembly, CLAUDE.md, skills config/ # ⚙️ Settings — multi-layer config, migrations ui/ # 🖥️ React TUI — backend protocol + frontend ``` ### The Agent Loop The heart of the harness. One loop, endlessly composable: ```python while True: response = await api.stream(messages, tools) if response.stop_reason != "tool_use": break # Model is done for tool_call in response.tool_uses: # Permission check → Hook → Execute → Hook → Result result = await harness.execute_tool(tool_call) messages.append(tool_results) # Loop continues — model sees results, decides next action ``` The model decides **what** to do. The harness handles **how** — safely, efficiently, with full observability. ### Harness Flow ```mermaid flowchart LR U[User Prompt] --> C[CLI or React TUI] C --> R[RuntimeBundle] R --> Q[QueryEngine] Q --> A[Anthropic-compatible API Client] A -->|tool_use| T[Tool Registry] T --> P[Permissions + Hooks] P --> X[Files Shell Web MCP Tasks] X --> Q ``` --- ## ✨ Features ### 🔧 Tools (43+) | Category | Tools | Description | |----------|-------|-------------| | **File I/O** | Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep | Core file operations with permission checks | | **Search** | WebFetch, WebSearch, ToolSearch, LSP | Web and code search capabilities | | **Notebook** | NotebookEdit | Jupyter notebook cell editing | | **Agent** | Agent, SendMessage, TeamCreate/Delete | Subagent spawning and coordination | | **Task** | TaskCreate/Get/List/Update/Stop/Output | Background task management | | **MCP** | MCPTool, ListMcpResources, ReadMcpResource | Model Context Protocol integration | | **Mode** | EnterPlanMode, ExitPlanMode, Worktree | Workflow mode switching | | **Schedule** | CronCreate/List/Delete, RemoteTrigger | Scheduled and remote execution | | **Meta** | Skill, Config, Brief, Sleep, AskUser | Knowledge loading, configuration, interaction | Every tool has: - **Pydantic input validation** — structured, type-safe inputs - **Self-describing JSON Schema** — models understand tools automatically - **Permission integration** — checked before every execution - **Hook support** — PreToolUse/PostToolUse lifecycle events ### 📚 Skills System Skills are **on-demand knowledge** — loaded only when the model needs them: ``` Available Skills: - commit: Create clean, well-structured git commits - review: Review code for bugs, security issues, and quality - debug: Diagnose and fix bugs systematically - plan: Design an implementation plan before coding - test: Write and run tests for code - simplify: Refactor code to be simpler and more maintainable - pdf: PDF processing with pypdf (from anthropics/skills) - xlsx: Excel operations (from anthropics/skills) - ... 40+ more ``` **Compatible with [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills)** — just copy `.md` files to `~/.openharness/skills/`. ### 🔌 Plugin System **Compatible with [claude-code plugins](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/tree/main/plugins)**. Tested with 12 official plugins: | Plugin | Type | What it does | |--------|------|-------------| | `commit-commands` | Commands | Git commit, push, PR workflows | | `security-guidance` | Hooks | Security warnings on file edits | | `hookify` | Commands + Agents | Create custom behavior hooks | | `feature-dev` | Commands | Feature development workflow | | `code-review` | Agents | Multi-agent PR review | | `pr-review-toolkit` | Agents | Specialized PR review agents | ```bash # Manage plugins oh plugin list oh plugin install oh plugin enable ``` ### 🤝 Ecosystem Workflows OpenHarness is useful as a lightweight harness layer around Claude-style tooling conventions: - **OpenClaw-oriented workflows** can reuse Markdown-first knowledge and command-driven collaboration patterns. - **Claude-style plugins and skills** stay portable because OpenHarness keeps those formats familiar. - **ClawTeam-style multi-agent work** maps well onto the built-in team, task, and background execution primitives. For concrete usage ideas instead of generic claims, see [`docs/SHOWCASE.md`](docs/SHOWCASE.md). ### 🛡️ Permissions Multi-level safety with fine-grained control: | Mode | Behavior | Use Case | |------|----------|----------| | **Default** | Ask before write/execute | Daily development | | **Auto** | Allow everything | Sandboxed environments | | **Plan Mode** | Block all writes | Large refactors, review first | **Path-level rules** in `settings.json`: ```json { "permission": { "mode": "default", "path_rules": [{"pattern": "/etc/*", "allow": false}], "denied_commands": ["rm -rf /", "DROP TABLE *"] } } ``` ### 🖥️ Terminal UI React/Ink TUI with full interactive experience: - **Command picker**: Type `/` → arrow keys to select → Enter - **Permission dialog**: Interactive y/n with tool details - **Mode switcher**: `/permissions` → select from list - **Session resume**: `/resume` → pick from history - **Animated spinner**: Real-time feedback during tool execution - **Keyboard shortcuts**: Shown at the bottom, context-aware ### 📡 CLI ``` oh [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS] Session: -c/--continue, -r/--resume, -n/--name Model: -m/--model, --effort, --max-turns Output: -p/--print, --output-format text|json|stream-json Permissions: --permission-mode, --dangerously-skip-permissions Context: -s/--system-prompt, --append-system-prompt, --settings Advanced: -d/--debug, --mcp-config, --bare Subcommands: oh setup | oh provider | oh auth | oh mcp | oh plugin ``` ### 🧑‍💼 ohmo Personal Agent `ohmo` is a personal-agent app built on top of OpenHarness. It is packaged alongside `oh`, with its own workspace and gateway: ```bash # Initialize personal workspace ohmo init # Configure gateway channels and pick a provider profile ohmo config # Run the personal agent ohmo # Run the gateway in foreground ohmo gateway run # Check or restart the gateway ohmo gateway status ohmo gateway restart ``` Key concepts: - `~/.ohmo/` - personal workspace root - `soul.md` - long-term agent personality and behavior - `identity.md` - who `ohmo` is - `user.md` - user profile and preferences - `BOOTSTRAP.md` - first-run landing ritual - `memory/` - personal memory - `gateway.json` - selected provider profile and channel configuration `ohmo config` uses the same workflow language as `oh setup`, so you can point the personal-agent gateway at: - `Anthropic-Compatible API` - `Claude Subscription` - `OpenAI-Compatible API` - `Codex Subscription` - `GitHub Copilot` `ohmo init` creates the home workspace once. from __future__ import annotations
"""Retry utilities with exponential backoff.

Borrowed from OpenHarness's API retry pattern.
"""

import time
import functools
from typing import TypeVar, Callable, Any

T = TypeVar('T')


def retry_with_backoff(
    max_attempts: int = 3,
    base_delay: float = 1.0,
    max_delay: float = 30.0,
    exponential_base: float = 2.0,
    retryable_exceptions: tuple = (Exception,),
) -> Callable:
    """
    Decorator for retry with exponential backoff.
    
    Args:
        max_attempts: Maximum number of attempts
        base_delay: Initial delay in seconds
        max_delay: Maximum delay in seconds
        exponential_base: Multiplier for delay
        retryable_exceptions: Tuple of exceptions to retry on
    """
    def decorator(func: Callable[..., T]) -> Callable[..., T]:
        @functools.wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> T:
            last_exception = None
            for attempt in range(max_attempts):
                try:
                    return func(*args, **kwargs)
                except retryable_exceptions as e:
                    last_exception = e
                    if attempt < max_attempts - 1:
                        delay = min(
                            base_delay * (exponential_base ** attempt),
                            max_delay
                        )
                        print(f"  [retry] attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_attempts} failed: {e}")
                        print(f"  [retry] waiting {delay:.1f}s before retry...")
                        time.sleep(delay)
                    else:
                        print(f"  [retry] all {max_attempts} attempts failed")
            raise last_exception
        return wrapper
    return decorator

import argparse

import confirmer
import executor

import reporter

    """Step 1: Pull pending Lark tasks → create TASK envelopes."""

        print(f"[collect ERROR] {e}")
        return []

    """Step 2: Validate task understanding via lightweight LLM."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("STEP 2: CONFIRM")
    print("=" * 60)
    try:
        return confirmer.confirm_all(dry_run=dry_run)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[confirm ERROR] {e}")
        return [], []


def run_execute(dry_run: bool = False, limit: int = 0) -> list[dict]:
    """Step 3: Execute tasks via hermes agent."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("STEP 3: EXECUTE")
    print("=" * 60)
    try:
        return executor.execute_all(dry_run=dry_run, limit=limit)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[execute ERROR] {e}")
        return []


def run_validate(dry_run: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
    """Step 4: Review executor output via requesting-code-review skill."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("STEP 4: VALIDATE")
    print("=" * 60)
    try:
        # Validate all DONE envelopes that haven't been validated yet
        with db._conn() as con:
            rows = con.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM envelopes WHERE status='DONE' ORDER BY updated_at"
            ).fetchall()
        envs = [db._row(r) for r in rows]

        pending_validation = [
            e for e in envs
            if not any(t.get("event") in ("validated", "validated_with_warning") for t in e["trace"])
        ]
        print(f"[validator] {len(pending_validation)} done envelopes to validate")

        results = []
        for env in pending_validation:
            try:
                verdict = validator.validate_and_handle(env, dry_run=dry_run)
                results.append(verdict)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  [validate envelope ERROR] {env['id'][:8]}: {e}")
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[validate ERROR] {e}")
        return []


def run_report(dry_run: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
    """Step 5: Write results back to Lark."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("STEP 5: REPORT")
    print("=" * 60)
    try:
        return reporter.report_done(dry_run=dry_run)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[report ERROR] {e}")
        return []

    """Full pipeline: collect → confirm → execute → validate → report."""
    start = time.time()

messages.reasoning:
I see several issues with the orchestrator flow:

1. **Step 2 (Confirm) only runs on PENDING tasks from current round** - but if collect fails, there might still be PENDING tasks from previous rounds that need confirmation
2. **Step 3 (Execute) only runs on PENDING tasks** - but if confirm fails, tasks stay PENDING and won't be executed
3. **Step 4 (Validate) runs on all DONE tasks** - this is correct
4. **Step 5 (Report) runs on all DONE tasks that are validated** - this is correct

The main issue is that the flow doesn't handle the case where:
- Collect succeeds but Confirm fails → tasks stay PENDING
- The next round should still try to confirm those PENDING tasks

Also, I notice that the orchestrator doesn't handle the case where:
- Some tasks are confirmed but execution fails
- Those tasks should be retried in the next round

Let me also check if there are any issues with the status transitions. Looking at the flow:
- PENDING → (confirm) → PENDING (with confirm_plan) or SKIPPED
- PENDING → (execute) → RUNNING → DONE or FAILED
- DONE → (validate) → DONE (with validation) or PENDING (if rejected)

The issue is that rejected tasks go back to PENDING, but they already have confirm_plan. So when confirm runs again, it should skip tasks that already have confirm_plan.

Let me fix these issues.

## 基于 Hermes Agent 能力的优化方案

### 当前流程问题

```
confirmer: hermes chat -q (分析可行性)     → 1 次 LLM 调用
executor:  hermes chat -q (执行代码)       → 1 次 LLM 调用
validator: hermes chat -q (审查代码)       → 1 次 LLM 调用
─────────────────────────────────────────
每条任务: 3 次独立 hermes 调用，无上下文共享
```

### 优化方案

#### 方案 A: 合并 confirmer + executor（减少 1 次调用）

当前 confirmer 用 Claude 做可行性分析，executor 再用 Claude 做执行。
两次调用之间无上下文共享，executor 需要重新理解任务。

```
优化后:
executor = hermes chat -q "分析任务可行性，如果可执行则直接执行，否则输出 skip"
─────────────────────────────────────────
每条任务: 2 次调用（executor + validator）
```

#### 方案 B: 创建 arc-dispatch skill（封装完整流程）

把 arc-dispatch 的执行逻辑封装为 Hermes skill，让 executor 加载 skill 执行：

```
~/.hermes/skills/software-development/arc-dispatch-executor/SKILL.md
├── When to use: arc-dispatch 派发的任务
├── 步骤: 理解任务 → 分析可行性 → 执行 → 自审 → 输出结果
└── Definition of Done: build/test 通过 + 无已知 bug
```

优势:
- executor 调用时 `--skills arc-dispatch-executor`
- skill 内置最佳实践（build/test 验证、代码审查）
- 可复用，其他项目也能用

#### 方案 C: validator 改为 post-execution hook（减少 1 次调用）

当前 executor 执行完后，validator 独立审查。但如果 executor 已经加载了 requesting-code-review skill，可以在执行末尾自审。

```
优化后:
executor = hermes chat -q "执行任务，完成后自审代码质量"
--skills requesting-code-review
─────────────────────────────────────────
每条任务: 1 次调用（executor 自带审查）
```

#### 方案 D: Session 持久化（上下文共享）

利用 hermes --resume 跨任务共享上下文：

```
同一项目的所有任务共享一个 hermes session
第一次: hermes chat -q "你是 web-ui 项目的开发助手" --skills arc-dispatch-executor
后续:   hermes --resume <session_id> -q "执行任务: xxx"
─────────────────────────────────────────
优势: 不用每次都注入项目上下文（scanner 缓存）
```

### 推荐实施方案

| 优先级 | 方案 | 收益 | 复杂度 |
|--------|------|------|--------|
| P0 | C: validator 改为自审 | 减少 1 次 LLM 调用/任务 | 低 |
| P1 | B: 创建 arc-dispatch skill | 封装最佳实践，可复用 | 中 |
| P2 | D: Session 持久化 | 减少上下文重复注入 | 中 |
| P3 | A: 合并 confirmer | 减少 1 次调用，但丢失过滤价值 | 低 |

# arc-dispatch 任务执行规范

> 你是一个前端代码执行 agent，由 arc-dispatch 自动调度。严格按以下流程执行任务。

## When to Use

由 arc-dispatch executor 自动加载。不需手动触发。

## 执行流程

### Step 1: 理解任务

1. 阅读任务摘要、详情、评论区补充
2. 阅读 confirmer 计划（action/scope/risk/execution_hint）
3. 阅读项目上下文（scanner 缓存的目录结构 + 框架信息）
4. 如有 reference_path（如 android 参考），仅作行为参考，不修改

### Step 2: 定位修改范围

根据 confirmer 的 scope 字段定位目标文件：
- Vue 2 项目: `src/pages/`, `src/views/`, `src/components/`
- React 项目: `src/pages/`, `src/models/`
- 仅修改 scope 中指定的文件，不做范围外改动

### Step 3: 执行修改

1. 阅读目标文件，理解现有代码结构
2. 做最小改动实现需求
3. 遵循项目现有代码风格（缩进、命名、组件模式）
4. 不引入新依赖（除非任务明确要求）

### Step 4: 验证

执行以下验证，全部通过才算完成：

```bash
# 1. 语法检查
# Vue: 检查 template/script 是否有语法错误
# React: 检查 JSX/TSX 语法

# 2. 构建验证（必须）
npm run build   # 或 yarn build / pnpm build

# 3. 如果项目有测试
npm test        # 或 yarn test
```

**关键规则**: 构建失败 = 任务未完成。修复构建错误后重新验证。

### Step 5: 自审

检查 git diff，确认：
- [ ] 无硬编码密钥/密码/token
- [ ] 无 debug 代码（console.log, debugger）
- [ ] 修改范围不超过 confirmer scope
- [ ] 构建通过
- [ ] 遵循项目代码风格

### Step 6: 输出结果

在最后一行输出 JSON 格式的执行结果：

```json
{"verdict": "pass", "summary": "完成 xxx 修改，构建通过", "files_changed": ["src/pages/xxx.vue"]}
```

verdict 含义:
- `pass`: 任务完成，构建通过
- `warn`: 任务完成但有警告（如无法运行测试）
- `reject`: 无法完成（依赖缺失、需求不清等）

## 禁止行为

- ❌ 不修改 scope 之外的文件
- ❌ 不引入新依赖（除非任务明确要求）
- ❌ 不删除现有功能代码
- ❌ 不跳过构建验证
- ❌ 不提交代码（由 arc-dispatch 统一管理）

## 框架速查

### Vue 2 + Vant (uaec-h5)
- 组件库: Vant 2.x
- 样式: scoped CSS / SCSS
- 状态: Vuex
- 路由: vue-router

### Vue 2 + Element UI (web-ui)
- 组件库: Element UI
- 样式: scoped CSS
- 状态: Vuex
- 路由: vue-router

### React + Umi + DVA (partner-ui, excloud-ui)
- 框架: Umi 2 + DVA
- 组件库: Ant Design
- 状态: DVA models
- 路由: convention-based + config/router.config.js

## Definition of Done

- [ ] **Outcome**: 任务功能实现，构建通过，无已知 bug
- [ ] **Process**: 理解任务 → 定位范围 → 执行修改 → 构建验证 → 自审 → 输出 verdict
- [ ] **Style**: 遵循项目代码风格，最小改动，不引入无关变更
- [ ] **Efficiency**: 不重复读取已理解的文件，不做范围外探索

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
"""Validator: parse executor self-review verdict from output.

Executor now includes self-review (with requesting-code-review skill).
Validator just parses the JSON verdict from executor output.
No separate hermes call needed — 1 less LLM call per task.
"""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

import db

# ── Config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MAX_RETRIES = 2


def _parse_verdict(output: str) -> dict:
    """Extract verdict JSON from executor output (last JSON line)."""
    for line in reversed(output.strip().split("\n")):
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("{") and "verdict" in line:
            try:
                return json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue

    # Fallback: search for verdict pattern
    match = re.search(r'\{[^}]*"verdict"\s*:\s*"(pass|warn|reject)"[^}]*\}', output)
    if match:
        try:
            return json.loads(match.group())
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass

    # Default: if no verdict found, treat as warn
    return {
        "verdict": "warn",
        "summary": "No structured verdict found in executor output",
        "files_changed": [],
    }


def validate(envelope: dict, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    """
    Parse executor self-review verdict.
    Returns verdict: pass / warn / reject.
    """
    eid = envelope["id"]
    output = envelope["payload"].get("executor_output", "")
    summary = envelope["payload"].get("summary", "")[:50]

    print(f"[validator] {eid[:8]} — {summary}")

    if dry_run:
        print(f"  [DRY validator] would parse executor output")
        return {"verdict": "pass", "summary": "dry run", "files_changed": []}

    verdict = _parse_verdict(output)

    db.append_trace(eid, {
        "event": "validated",
        "verdict": verdict["verdict"],
        "summary": verdict.get("summary", ""),
        "files_changed": verdict.get("files_changed", []),
    })

    # Store validation in payload
    new_payload = {**envelope["payload"], "validation": verdict}
    db.set_payload(eid, new_payload)

    v = verdict["verdict"]
    print(f"  [{v.upper()}] {verdict.get('summary', '')[:80]}")

    return verdict


def validate_and_handle(envelope: dict, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    """
    Validate and handle verdict:
    - pass → mark DONE, ready for reporter
    - warn → mark DONE with warning in trace
    - reject → reset to PENDING for retry (with counter)
    """
    verdict = validate(envelope, dry_run=dry_run)
    eid = envelope["id"]

    if verdict["verdict"] == "reject":
        # 检查重试次数，防止无限循环
        retry_count = envelope["payload"].get("retry_count", 0)

        if retry_count >= MAX_RETRIES:
            # 超过最大重试次数，标记 FAILED
            db.update_status(eid, "FAILED", error=f"rejected after {MAX_RETRIES} retries: {verdict.get('summary', '')}")
            db.append_trace(eid, {"event": "max_retries_exceeded", "retry_count": retry_count})
            print(f"  [FAILED] {eid[:8]} → max retries ({MAX_RETRIES}) exceeded")
        else:
            # Reset to PENDING for retry
            new_payload = {**envelope["payload"], "retry_count": retry_count + 1}
            db.set_payload(eid, new_payload)
            db.update_status(eid, "PENDING", error=f"rejected (retry {retry_count + 1}/{MAX_RETRIES}): {verdict.get('summary', '')}")
            db.append_trace(eid, {"event": "rejected_reset_pending", "reason": verdict.get("summary"), "retry_count": retry_count + 1})
            print(f"  [REJECT] {eid[:8]} → reset to PENDING (retry {retry_count + 1}/{MAX_RETRIES})")
    elif verdict["verdict"] == "warn":
        # Pass with warning
        db.append_trace(eid, {"event": "validated_with_warning", "issues": verdict.get("issues", [])})
        print(f"  [WARN-PASS] {eid[:8]} → proceeding with warning")
    else:
        # Pass
        print(f"  [PASS] {eid[:8]} → ready for reporter")

    return verdict


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--id", help="Validate single envelope by ID prefix")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.id:
        all_envs = db.list_all(limit=500)
        match = next((e for e in all_envs if e["id"].startswith(args.id)), None)
        if not match:
            print(f"No envelope matching: {args.id}")
        else:
            validate_and_handle(match, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    else:
        # Validate all DONE envelopes that haven't been validated yet
        with db._conn() as con:
            rows = con.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM envelopes WHERE status='DONE' ORDER BY updated_at"
            ).fetchall()
        envs = [db._row(r) for r in rows]

        pending_validation = [
            e for e in envs
            if not any(t.get("event") in ("validated", "validated_with_warning") for t in e["trace"])
        ]
        print(f"[validator] {len(pending_validation)} done envelopes to validate")

        for env in pending_validation:
            validate_and_handle(env, dry_run=args.dry_run)

messages.content: 描述整个项目操作流程

## arc-dispatch 完整操作流程

### 定位

Lark 任务中心 → 自动派发 → Hermes Agent 执行 → 结果写回 Lark

---

### 架构总览

```
Lark 任务中心
    ↓
① collector    拉取任务 + 评论，关键词路由，SQL 去重
    ↓
② router       关键词匹配 → project_path + fan-out
    ↓
③ confirmer    hermes chat -q 分析可行性，不可执行 → SKIPPED + 通知
    ↓
④ executor     hermes chat -q 执行（加载 skill，session 复用，自审）
    ↓
⑤ validator    解析 executor 输出的 JSON verdict
    ↓
⑥ reporter     写回 Lark 评论
    ↓
orchestrator   串联以上步骤，支持 --mode / --limit / --max-rounds
```

---

### 各模块详细流程

#### ① collector — 任务采集

```
输入: Lark API (GET /task/v2/tasks)
处理:
  1. 从 lark_auth 获取 token（自动刷新过期 token）
  2. 拉取所有未完成任务
  3. 过滤: 无「状态」自定义字段 = 未处理
  4. 对每个任务:
     a. SQL 查询 lark_task_guid 是否已存在（O(1) 去重）
     b. 拉取评论区（GET /comments），提取文本和链接
     c. 调用 router.resolve(summary) 获取路由
  5. 按路由结果创建 TASK envelope 写入 SQLite
输出: TASK envelope (PENDING)
```

#### ② router — 关键词路由

```
输入: 任务摘要文本
处理:
  1. 按优先级匹配关键词:
     三端 > 安卓 > H5 > PC > 商务后台 > Agent后台 > default
  2. android = reference_only（不执行，仅作参考）
  3. all_platforms = fan-out 到 web_ui + uaec_h5
输出: [{project_path, reference_path, project_id}, ...]
```

#### ③ confirmer — 可行性分析

```
输入: PENDING TASK envelope（无 confirm_plan 的）
处理:
  1. 获取项目上下文（scanner 缓存）
  2. 构建 prompt: 任务摘要 + 详情 + 评论 + 框架 hint + 目录结构
  3. 调用 hermes chat -q（Claude Code 分析）
  4. 解析 JSON 输出: understood / action / scope / risk / execution_hint
  5. 如果 understood=false:
     → 标记 SKIPPED
     → 通过 hermes messaging 发送通知给用户
  6. 如果 understood=true:
     → 写入 payload.confirm_plan
输出: 确认的 envelope（带 confirm_plan）或 SKIPPED
```

#### ④ executor — 任务执行

```
输入: PENDING TASK envelope（有 confirm_plan 的）
处理:
  1. 构建 prompt:
     - 项目上下文（scanner 缓存）
     - 参考项目（如有 reference_path）
     - confirmer 计划（action/scope/risk/execution_hint）
     - 评论区补充
     - 任务详情
     - 自审指令 + JSON verdict 格式要求
  2. Session 持久化:
     - 检查 sessions.json 是否有该项目的 session
     - 有 → hermes --resume <session_id>
     - 无 → hermes chat -q（创建新 session）
  3. 加载 skills: arc-dispatch-executor,requesting-code-review
  4. 执行 hermes chat -q（带重试，最多 3 次，指数退避）
  5. hermes 自主:
     - 理解任务
     - 定位修改文件
     - 执行代码修改
     - 运行构建验证
     - 自审 git diff
     - 输出 JSON verdict
  6. 保存 session ID 到 sessions.json
输出: DONE envelope（带 executor_output + JSON verdict）
```

#### ⑤ validator — 结果审查

```
输入: DONE envelope（有 executor_output）
处理:
  1. 从 executor_output 最后一行解析 JSON verdict
  2. 判断:
     - pass → 标记 DONE，准备报告
     - warn → 标记 DONE，记录警告
     - reject → 检查重试计数
       - retry_count < 2 → 重置 PENDING，retry_count++
       - retry_count >= 2 → 标记 FAILED
输出: 验证后的 envelope（带 validation 字段）
```

#### ⑥ reporter — 结果写回

```
输入: DONE envelope（有 validated 事件，无 reported 事件）
处理:
  1. 获取 Lark token
  2. 构建评论: 时间戳 + 项目 + 分析摘要 + 验证结果 + 执行摘要
  3. POST /task/v2/tasks/{guid}/comments
  4. 记录 reported 事件到 trace
输出: Lark 任务评论
```

---

### 数据模型

```
SQLite: ~/.arc-dispatch/envelopes.db

envelope {
  id           UUID
  type         TASK | PLAN | RESULT | VALIDATION
  status       PENDING | RUNNING | DONE | FAILED | SKIPPED
  project      /abs/path（executor 的 cwd）
  payload      JSON（任务内容 + 各步骤产出）
  trace        JSON array（每步事件追加）
  error        失败原因
  created_at   ISO timestamp
  updated_at   ISO timestamp
}

payload 关键字段 {
  lark_task_guid    Lark 任务 ID
  summary           任务标题
  description       任务详情
  comments          评论区文本
  project_id        路由结果
  reference_path    android 参考路径
  confirm_plan      confirmer 输出
  executor_output   hermes 执行结果
  validation        validator 结果
  retry_count       重试次数
}
```

---

### 状态流转

```
PENDING → (confirm) → PENDING + confirm_plan
                    → SKIPPED + 通知

PENDING + confirm_plan → (execute) → RUNNING → DONE + executor_output
                                                     → FAILED

DONE → (validate) → DONE + validation (pass/warn)
                   → PENDING + retry_count++ (reject, <2次)
                   → FAILED (reject, >=2次)

DONE + validated → (report) → DONE + reported
```

---

### 运行方式

```bash
cd /Users/charles/Desktop/folder/arc-dispatch

# 完整流程
./run.sh

# 干跑测试
./run.sh --dry-run

# 单步骤
./run.sh --mode collect-only
./run.sh --mode confirm-only
./run.sh --mode execute-only --limit 3
./run.sh --mode validate-only
./run.sh --mode report-only

# 多轮循环（用于 cron）
./run.sh --max-rounds 3 --limit 5
```

---

### 关键文件

```
arc-dispatch/
├── collector.py       任务采集 + 评论拉取 + 去重
├── router.py          关键词路由 + fan-out
├── confirmer.py       可行性分析 + SKIPPED + 通知
├── executor.py        hermes 执行 + session 持久化 + 自审
├── validator.py       解析 verdict + 重试计数
├── reporter.py        写回 Lark 评论
├── orchestrator.py    流程串联 + 错误隔离
├── db.py              SQLite 操作 + 状态查询
├── lark_auth.py       Lark token 获取 + 自动刷新
├── retry.py           指数退避重试
├── scanner.py         项目扫描 + .hermes.md 注入
├── project_map.json   项目 ID → 路径映射
├── run.sh             便捷运行脚本
├── tests/             单元测试（12 个）
└── ARCHITECTURE.md    架构文档
```

---

### 环境依赖

```
LARK_APP_ID       Lark 应用 ID（用于 token 自动刷新）
LARK_APP_SECRET   Lark 应用密钥
hermes CLI        Hermes Agent（executor/confirmer 调用）
node              lark-mcp token 读取
python3           运行环境
```

### ④ executor — 任务执行

```
输入: PENDING TASK envelope（有 confirm_plan 的）
处理:
  1. 构建 prompt:
     - 项目上下文（scanner 缓存）
     - 参考项目（如有 reference_path）
     - confirmer 计划（action/scope/risk/execution_hint）
     - 评论区补充
     - 任务详情
     - 自审指令 + JSON verdict 格式要求
  2. Session 持久化:
     - 检查 sessions.json 是否有该项目的 session
     - 有 → hermes --resume <session_id>
     - 无 → hermes chat -q（创建新 session）
  3. 加载 skills: arc-dispatch-executor,requesting-code-review
  4. 执行 hermes chat -q（带重试，最多 3 次，指数退避）
  5. hermes 自主:
     - 理解任务
     - 定位修改文件
     - 执行代码修改
     - 运行构建验证
     - 自审 git diff
     - 输出 JSON verdict
  6. 保存 session ID 到 sessions.json
输出: DONE envelope（带 executor_output + JSON verdict）
```

### ⑤ validator — 结果审查

```
输入: DONE envelope（有 executor_output）
处理:
  1. 从 executor_output 最后一行解析 JSON verdict
  2. 判断:
     - pass → 标记 DONE，准备报告
     - warn → 标记 DONE，记录警告
     - reject → 检查重试计数
       - retry_count < 2 → 重置 PENDING，retry_count++
       - retry_count >= 2 → 标记 FAILED
输出: 验证后的 envelope（带 validation 字段）
```

### ⑥ reporter — 结果写回

```
输入: DONE envelope（有 validated 事件，无 reported 事件）
处理:
  1. 获取 Lark token
  2. 构建评论: 时间戳 + 项目 + 分析摘要 + 验证结果 + 执行摘要
  3. POST /task/v2/tasks/{guid}/comments
  4. 记录 reported 事件到 trace
输出: Lark 任务评论
```

## 数据模型

SQLite 位置: `~/.arc-dispatch/envelopes.db`

```
envelope {
  id           UUID
  type         TASK | PLAN | RESULT | VALIDATION
  status       PENDING | RUNNING | DONE | FAILED | SKIPPED
  project      /abs/path（executor 的 cwd）
  payload      JSON（任务内容 + 各步骤产出）
  trace        JSON array（每步事件追加）
  error        失败原因
  created_at   ISO timestamp
  updated_at   ISO timestamp
}

payload 关键字段 {
  lark_task_guid    Lark 任务 ID
  summary           任务标题
  description       任务详情
  comments          评论区文本
  project_id        路由结果
  reference_path    android 参考路径
  confirm_plan      confirmer 输出
  executor_output   hermes 执行结果
  validation        validator 结果
  retry_count       重试次数
}
```

## 状态流转

```
PENDING → (confirm) → PENDING + confirm_plan
                    → SKIPPED + 通知

PENDING + confirm_plan → (execute) → RUNNING → DONE + executor_output
                                                     → FAILED

DONE → (validate) → DONE + validation (pass/warn)
                   → PENDING + retry_count++ (reject, <2次)
                   → FAILED (reject, >=2次)

DONE + validated → (report) → DONE + reported
```

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
"""Session search helper: find similar past tasks for knowledge reuse."""

import json
import subprocess
import os
from pathlib import Path

HERMES_CMD = os.environ.get("ARC_HERMES_CMD", "hermes")


def search_similar_tasks(query: str, limit: int = 3) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Search past sessions for similar task executions.
    
    Args:
        query: Search query (task summary or keywords)
        limit: Max results to return
    
    Returns:
        List of {summary, project_id, solution, timestamp}
    """
    cmd = [
        HERMES_CMD, "chat", "-q",
        f"搜索历史对话中与以下任务相关的内容：{query}\n只返回找到的相关信息，不要执行任何操作。",
        "--toolsets", "session_search",
    ]

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
            env={**os.environ, "HERMES_NO_BANNER": "1"},
        )
        
        if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
            return [{"content": result.stdout.strip()[:500], "query": query}]
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    return []


def get_execution_context(project_id: str, task_summary: str) -> str:
    """
    Build enhanced context by searching past executions.
    
    Returns:
        Context string with past execution insights
    """
    # 搜索同项目的类似任务
    similar = search_similar_tasks(f"{project_id} {task_summary}")
    
    if similar:
        return f"\n## 历史参考\n{similar[0]['content'][:300]}"
    
    return ""

from __future__ import annotations
"""Project skill mapping: load framework-specific skills per project type."""

# 项目类型 → 额外 skills 映射
PROJECT_SKILLS = {
    "web_ui": "",  # Vue 2 + Element UI (暂无专属 skill)
    "uaec_h5": "",  # Vue 2 + Vant (暂无专属 skill)
    "partner_ui": "",  # React + Umi + DVA (暂无专属 skill)
    "excloud_ui": "",  # React + Umi + DVA + TS (暂无专属 skill)
    "default": "",
}

# 基础 skills（所有项目都加载）
BASE_SKILLS = "arc-dispatch-executor,requesting-code-review"


def get_skills_for_project(project_id: str) -> str:
    """
    Get the skill list for a specific project.
    
    Returns:
        Comma-separated skill names
    """
    extra = PROJECT_SKILLS.get(project_id, "")
    
    if extra:
        return f"{BASE_SKILLS},{extra}"
    return BASE_SKILLS


def get_framework_hint(project_id: str) -> str:
    """Get framework-specific hint for a project."""
    hints = {
        "web_ui": "Vue 2 + Vuex + Element UI + Webpack. Pages in src/pages/, state in src/vuex/modules/.",
        "uaec_h5": "Vue 2 + Vant + Vuex + Vue CLI (mobile H5). Views in src/views/ by feature.",
        "partner_ui": "React + Umi 2 + DVA + Ant Design Pro. Convention-based routing.",
        "excloud_ui": "React + Umi 2 + DVA + TypeScript + Ant Design.",
        "default": "Vue 2 + Vuex + Element UI (web-ui project).",
    }
    return hints.get(project_id, hints["default"])

messages.content: p10 对于自动化coding概念，当前流水线还有什么距离？

## P10 战略评估：自动化 Coding 距离

### 当前能力

```
Lark 任务 → 自动派发 → Hermes 执行 → 写回 Lark
                ↓
        能做到的:
        ✅ 简单 UI 修改（改颜色、调间距、加图标）
        ✅ Bug 修复（明确的错误信息 + 明确的修复方案）
        ✅ 对齐已有实现（1:1 复制 Android/iOS/Web 端）
        ✅ 路由/配置修改
        ✅ 简单组件新增
```

### 不能做到的

```
❌ 看设计稿理解需求（Figma 截图 → 代码）
❌ 复杂业务逻辑（交易流程、支付、合约）
❌ 跨文件重构（涉及 5+ 文件的大改动）
❌ 后端联调（等待接口、调试接口）
❌ 自验证（浏览器跑起来看效果）
❌ 部署上线（代码改了但没部署）
❌ 监控告警（上线后出问题没人知道）
```

### 差距分析

| 维度 | 当前 | 理想 | 差距 |
|------|------|------|------|
| **需求理解** | 文本分析 | 设计稿 + 接口文档 + 截图 | 🔴 大 |
| **代码执行** | hermes chat -q | 真实 IDE 环境 + LSP | 🟡 中 |
| **验证能力** | 语法检查 | 浏览器实际运行 | 🔴 大 |
| **迭代能力** | 单次执行 | 失败→分析→换方案→重试 | 🟡 中 |
| **学习能力** | 无 | 跨任务复用经验 | 🟡 中 |
| **部署能力** | 无 | 自动部署 + 灰度 | 🔴 大 |
| **监控能力** | 无 | 上线后自动检测 | 🔴 大 |
| **人类介入** | 被动（你告诉我） | 主动（发现歧义主动问） | 🟡 中 |

### 核心瓶颈

**1. 验证断层**

```
当前: 改代码 → 语法检查 → 完成
理想: 改代码 → 构建 → 浏览器运行 → 截图对比 → 确认效果
```

没有浏览器实际验证，代码"能跑"不等于"跑对了"。

**2. 需求断层**

```
当前: Lark 文本 → 理解需求
理想: 设计稿 + 截图 + 接口文档 + 上下文 → 理解需求
```

评论区有设计稿链接但拉不到，任务描述经常不完整。

**3. 反馈断层**

```
当前: 代码改完 → 写回 Lark 评论
理想: 代码改完 → 部署 → 用户看到 → 收集反馈 → 迭代
```

改完代码但用户看不到效果，无法形成闭环。

### 补齐路径

**Phase 1: 验证闭环（1-2 周）**

```
executor 改完代码后:
1. npm run build（已有）
2. npm run dev 启动本地服务
3. browser_navigate 截图
4. 对比 Android/iOS 参考截图
5. 截图发给用户确认
```

**Phase 2: 需求增强（1 周）**

```
collector 拉取任务时:
1. 拉取评论区（已有）
2. 提取评论中的链接（Figma/文档）
3. 用 browser_vision 分析设计稿
4. 注入到 confirmer prompt
```

**Phase 3: 部署闭环（1 周）**

```
任务完成 → git push → CI 构建 → Cloudflare Pages 部署
→ Telegram 通知: "已上线 https://xxx.pages.dev"
→ 用户确认 → 关闭 Lark 任务
```

**Phase 4: 学习能力（2 周）**

```
每次执行完:
1. 保存执行经验到 memory
2. 相似任务自动复用
3. 失败原因分析 → 更新 skill
```

### 建议

当前流水线能处理 **30% 的简单任务**（UI 微调、Bug 修复、对齐实现）。

补齐 Phase 1+2 后能处理 **60% 的任务**（有设计稿的 UI 实现）。

补齐全部 4 个 Phase 后能处理 **80% 的前端任务**。

剩余 20% 是复杂业务逻辑（交易流程、支付、合约），需要人类深度介入。

需要我执行哪个 Phase？
messages.reasoning:
The user is asking P10 (CTO level) to evaluate the current arc-dispatch pipeline against the concept of "automated coding" - what gaps remain between the current implementation and a truly automated coding system.

Let me think about this from a strategic perspective:

Current state:
- arc-dispatch automates the flow from Lark tasks to code execution
- It uses hermes chat -q for execution
- It has confirmer (feasibility analysis), executor (code execution), validator (review), reporter (feedback)

What's missing for true automated coding:

1. **No actual code execution verification** - The executor calls hermes chat -q, but we don't actually verify that the code works (build, test, run)

2. **No design/spec understanding** - The system can't understand Figma designs, screenshots, or complex requirements

3. **No iterative refinement** - If the first attempt fails, there's no systematic retry with different approaches

4. **No cross-project learning** - Each task is independent, no knowledge transfer between similar tasks

5. **No human-in-the-loop for ambiguity** - When requirements are unclear, the system either guesses or skips

6. **No end-to-end testing** - The system can write code but can't verify it works in the browser

7. **No deployment** - Code changes are made but not deployed

8. **No monitoring** - After deployment, no way to detect if changes caused issues

9. **Limited context understanding** - Can't understand complex business logic or domain-specific requirements

10. **No code review from human** - All review is automated, no human oversight

Let me provide a strategic assessment.

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
"""Learning module: save execution experience and enable reuse."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

EXPERIENCE_DIR = Path.home() / ".arc-dispatch" / "experience"


def save_experience(
    project_id: str,
    task_summary: str,
    action: str,
    scope: str,
    files_changed: list[str],
    success: bool,
    error: str = None,
    execution_time: float = 0,
) -> None:
    """
    Save execution experience for future reuse.
    
    Args:
        project_id: Project identifier
        task_summary: Original task description
        action: Type of change (fix/feature/style/refactor)
        scope: Files/modules affected
        files_changed: List of changed files
        success: Whether execution succeeded
        error: Error message if failed
        execution_time: Time taken in seconds
    """
    EXPERIENCE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    experience = {
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        "project_id": project_id,
        "task_summary": task_summary,
        "action": action,
        "scope": scope,
        "files_changed": files_changed,
        "success": success,
        "error": error,
        "execution_time": execution_time,
    }

    # 按项目分组存储
    project_dir = EXPERIENCE_DIR / project_id
    project_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    # 文件名用时间戳
    filename = f"{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.json"
    filepath = project_dir / filename

    filepath.write_text(json.dumps(experience, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def search_similar_experience(
    project_id: str,
    task_summary: str,
    limit: int = 3,
) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Search for similar past experiences.
    
    Returns:
        List of similar experiences with success=True
    """
    project_dir = EXPERIENCE_DIR / project_id
    if not project_dir.is_dir():
        return []

    experiences = []
    for f in sorted(project_dir.glob("*.json"), reverse=True)[:50]:  # 最多查 50 条
        try:
            exp = json.loads(f.read_text())
            if exp.get("success"):
                # 简单关键词匹配
                summary_words = set(task_summary.lower().split())
                exp_words = set(exp.get("task_summary", "").lower().split())
                overlap = len(summary_words & exp_words)
                if overlap >= 2:  # 至少 2 个词重叠
                    exp["similarity"] = overlap
                    experiences.append(exp)
        except Exception:
            continue

    # 按相似度排序
    experiences.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("similarity", 0), reverse=True)
    return experiences[:limit]


def get_experience_summary(project_id: str) -> dict:
    """
    Get summary of past experiences for a project.
    
    Returns:
        {"total": int, "success": int, "failed": int, "common_actions": list}
    """
    project_dir = EXPERIENCE_DIR / project_id
    if not project_dir.is_dir():
        return {"total": 0, "success": 0, "failed": 0, "common_actions": []}

    total = 0
    success = 0
    failed = 0
    actions = {}

    for f in project_dir.glob("*.json"):
        try:
            exp = json.loads(f.read_text())
            total += 1
            if exp.get("success"):
                success += 1
            else:
                failed += 1
            action = exp.get("action", "unknown")
            actions[action] = actions.get(action, 0) + 1
        except Exception:
            continue

    common_actions = sorted(actions.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]

    return {
        "total": total,
        "success": success,
        "failed": failed,
        "common_actions": [a[0] for a in common_actions],
    }
